{{Top|leg}}
'''Pressure trips''' were a specialized form of [[sensor trip]] that used an automated [[pressure sensor]]. Installed in a mat that registered if any pressure was applied to it, it could be used to detect both vehicles and personnel. [[Zone Supplies, Ltd.]] manufactured the [[Pressure Plate Trip]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
